summary: Watch Production interaction bugfix. Owner reported that the ellipsis trigger visibly flickers while the shared action-menu popover is open. The cause is hover/focus ownership changing when the popover enters the browser top layer while Watch intentionally hides/translates the action container outside active-card state. V2.47.159 pins an explicit vf-action-menu-open state on the shared action container and owning asset row for the lifetime of the popover, and Watch terminal CSS keeps the trigger fully visible/stationary while open. Poster Shelf geometry, Watch frozen Body Grammar, shared menu labels, data model, schema, auth/security, updater mechanism and Production are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies from the current bounded continuation authorization; OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Production remains Owner manual.
